name: great helm
_design_note: F40-80 heavy head slot. Full-face enclosure trades vision for pierce resist. Heavier than plate_helm but no extra base AC — the tradeoff is the resist line, not the number.
lore_template: A full-face {material_name} great helm that encloses the entire head in a shell of tempered metal, with only a narrow vision slit at the eye line. Pierce attacks find no purchase on its seamless exterior; the trade-off is severely restricted peripheral vision and hearing.
